_doc: C8 — Ground-truth fixtures for the M&A extraction pipeline. Each case is a real-world-shaped headline+summary with the values a human verified. Used by tests/test_ma_extraction.py to score precision of value/basis parsing and deal_class classification. Extend this set as new failure modes are found; CI gates on it.
